exposure: Deliveries at University of Arizona Medical Center vs. St Joseph's Hospital
Borderline amniotic fluid index (AFI) in the third trimester (defined as >5 and <10 cm)
Borderline AFI vs. normal AFI (≥ 10-24 cm)
cohort: 739 pregnant patients: 177 with borderline AFI and 562 with normal AFI
finding: No significant difference in the rate of fetal intolerance of labor was found between pregnancies with a borderline AFI and those with a normal AFI.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery for fetal intolerance was not significantly different between the groups (P = .074).
